nodes.label: Exact Pocklington certificate
nodes.notes: Replay the modular powers and gcds using unbounded integers.
nodes.statement_markdown: For $p=147457$, $$p-1=2^{14}3^2,\qquad 10^{147456}\equiv1\pmod p,$$ $$10^{73728}\equiv147456\pmod p,\qquad 10^{49152}\equiv78348\pmod p,$$ and $$\gcd(147455,p)=\gcd(78347,p)=1.$$ Hence Pocklington's criterion gives $\operatorname{Prime}(p)$.

nodes.label: Fixed finite geometry
nodes.notes: Fix canonical field representatives, affine-line coordinates, incidence enumerations, and monomial order.
nodes.statement_markdown: Let $F=\mathbb F_{147457}$, $X=F^2$, $d=87$, and let $\mathcal L$ be the affine lines of $X$. Put $$M=|X|=21743566849,\qquad \Lambda=|\mathcal L|=21743714306,$$ $$N=|\{(L,x):x\in L\}|=3206262880419842,$$ $$H=10(p+1)=1474580,\qquad s=\binom{89}{2}=3916.$$ Thus $N=M(p+1)$ and $N/H=M/10$.

nodes.label: Integer acceptance and recovery semantics
nodes.notes: All probabilities are henceforth represented by exact integer counts.
nodes.statement_markdown: For $c=(f,(P_L)_{L\in\mathcal L})$, with $f:X\to F$ and $\deg P_L\le87$, define $$A(c)=|\{(L,x):x\in L,\ P_L(x)=f(x)\}|,$$ $$G(f)=\max_{\deg_{\mathrm{tot}}Q\le87}|\{x\in X:Q(x)=f(x)\}|.$$ Then $\operatorname{Pass}(c)=A(c)/N$, $\operatorname{Agr}_{87}(f)=G(f)/M$, and $$\operatorname{Sound}(\varepsilon)\Longleftrightarrow\forall c,\quad A(c)/N\ge\varepsilon\Longrightarrow G(f)/M\ge\varepsilon/10.$$ Let $$\mathcal S=\{\varepsilon\in\mathbb Q:0<\varepsilon\le1\ \land\ \operatorname{Sound}(\varepsilon)\}.$$

nodes.label: Exact integer score cells
nodes.notes: The strict failed-recovery inequality forces the open left endpoint.
nodes.statement_markdown: For $0<\varepsilon\le1$, set $$k=\lceil N\varepsilon\rceil,\qquad r_k=\left\lfloor\frac{k-1}{H}\right\rfloor.$$ Then $$\left\lceil\frac{M\varepsilon}{10}\right\rceil=r_k+1$$ and $$\neg\operatorname{Sound}(\varepsilon)\Longleftrightarrow\exists c:\ A(c)\ge k\ \land\ G(f)\le r_k.$$ Consequently, $\operatorname{Sound}$ is constant on $((k-1)/N,k/N]$.

nodes.label: Local Reed--Solomon score
nodes.notes: Each maximum is finite and uses the canonical line coordinate.
nodes.statement_markdown: Fix $t_L:F\to L$ for every line and define $$\lambda_L(f)=\max_{\deg R\le87}|\{x\in L:R(t_L^{-1}(x))=f(x)\}|,$$ $$T(f)=\sum_{L\in\mathcal L}\lambda_L(f).$$

nodes.label: Independent line maximization
nodes.notes: Line labels on distinct lines have no compatibility constraint.
nodes.statement_markdown: For every point table $f$, $$T(f)=\max_{(P_L)_{L\in\mathcal L}}A(f,(P_L)_L).$$

nodes.label: Exact bad-instance profile
nodes.notes: The sentinel $-1$ covers an empty constrained family.
nodes.statement_markdown: For $r\in\mathbb Z$, define $$C_r=\max\left(\{-1\}\cup\{T(f):f:X\to F,\ G(f)\le r\}\right).$$

nodes.label: Soundness as one integer inequality
nodes.notes: Equivalently, each table contributes the failure interval $(10G(f)/M,T(f)/N]$.
nodes.statement_markdown: For $0<\varepsilon\le1$, with $k=\lceil N\varepsilon\rceil$ and $r_k=\lfloor(k-1)/H\rfloor$, $$\operatorname{Sound}(\varepsilon)\Longleftrightarrow C_{r_k}<k.$$

nodes.label: Exact finite bad-instance program
nodes.notes: The program is enormous but finite; every index follows the canonical enumeration in `cc-ambient`.
nodes.statement_markdown: For integers $k,r$, let $\operatorname{BadIP}(k,r)$ have binary variables $z_{x,b}$, $u_{L,a}$, and $y_{L,x,b}$, where $b\in F$ and $a\in F^{88}$. Impose $$\sum_bz_{x,b}=1,\qquad\sum_au_{L,a}=1.$$ For $R_a(t)=\sum_{j=0}^{87}a_jt^j$, put $$v_{L,x,b}=\sum_{a:R_a(t_L^{-1}(x))=b}u_{L,a}$$ and impose $$y_{L,x,b}\le z_{x,b},\quad y_{L,x,b}\le v_{L,x,b},\quad y_{L,x,b}\ge z_{x,b}+v_{L,x,b}-1.$$ Finally impose $$\sum_{L,x\in L,b}y_{L,x,b}\ge k$$ and, for every coefficient word $q\in F^s$ with polynomial $Q_q$, $$\sum_{x\in X}z_{x,Q_q(x)}\le r.$$

nodes.label: Integer-program semantics
nodes.notes: The restriction $k\ge0$ avoids the sentinel counterexample when the $G\le r$ family is empty.
nodes.statement_markdown: For every integer $k\ge0$ and $r\in\mathbb Z$, $$\operatorname{BadIP}(k,r)\text{ is feasible}\Longleftrightarrow\exists c:\ A(c)\ge k\ \land\ G(f)\le r\Longleftrightarrow C_r\ge k.$$

nodes.label: Reed--Muller coset normalization
nodes.notes: Use the triangular Newton basis to prove the information-set bijection.
nodes.statement_markdown: Let $\mathcal C$ be the evaluation code of total-degree-at-most-$87$ bivariate polynomials and $\mathcal C_L$ the degree-at-most-$87$ code on $L$. Then $$G(f)=M-d_H(f,\mathcal C),\qquad T(f)=N-\sum_Ld_H(f|_L,\mathcal C_L).$$ For distinct $\alpha_0,\ldots,\alpha_{87}\in F$, let $$I=\{(\alpha_i,\alpha_j):i+j\le87\}.$$ Evaluation $\mathcal C\to F^I$ is bijective, $G$ and $T$ are invariant under $f\mapsto f+R$ for $R\in\mathcal C$, and every coset has a unique representative vanishing on $I$.

nodes.label: Eighty-eight-anchor local enumeration
nodes.notes: This replaces a scan over $p^{88}$ coefficient words by a still-enormous but smaller canonical subset scan.
nodes.statement_markdown: For every line $L$ and table $f$, one has $\lambda_L(f)\ge88$. Every maximizing degree-at-most-$87$ polynomial is determined by some $88$ of its agreement points. Hence $$\lambda_L(f)=\max_{\substack{S\subseteq L\\|S|=88}}|\{x\in L:R_S(x)=f(x)\}|,$$ where $R_S$ is the unique interpolant through $f|_S$.

nodes.label: Finite exhaustive decision procedure
nodes.notes: This establishes decidability, not practical tractability.
nodes.statement_markdown: Every $C_r$ is determined by enumerating the $$p^{M-s}=p^{21743562933}$$ tables vanishing on $I$. For each representative, scanning $p^{3916}$ global coefficient words computes $G(f)$, while scanning at most $\Lambda\binom{p}{88}$ anchored interpolants computes $T(f)$. Thus every predicate $C_r<k$ is an exact finite Boolean obligation.

nodes.label: Exact proof-checker kernels
nodes.notes: Suitable UNSAT kernels include LRAT, VeriPB, or exhaustive branching with exact nonnegative Farkas leaves.
nodes.statement_markdown: Canonical parsers and checkers satisfy $$\operatorname{Check}_{\mathrm{sat}}(F,w)=\mathrm{true}\Longrightarrow\operatorname{SAT}(F),$$ $$\operatorname{Check}_{\mathrm{unsat}}(F,\pi)=\mathrm{true}\Longrightarrow\neg\operatorname{SAT}(F),$$ and $$\operatorname{Check}_{\mathbb Q}(s,\alpha)=\mathrm{true}\Longrightarrow s$$ for every parsed closed integer-rational proposition $s$. Before parsing referenced bytes, each checker validates manifest lengths and SHA-256 digests.

nodes.label: Deterministic formula generation
nodes.notes: A digest identifies bytes but does not prove semantic refinement.
nodes.statement_markdown: A deterministic generator emits canonical pseudo-Boolean or CNF bytes $F_{k,r}$ satisfying $$\operatorname{SAT}(F_{k,r})\Longleftrightarrow\operatorname{BadIP}(k,r)\text{ is feasible}.$$ The equivalence covers the emitted field, geometry, evaluation, cardinality, and auxiliary-variable encodings.

nodes.label: Accepted certificates classify a cell
nodes.notes: This is the small trusted composition theorem; checker and generator soundness remain open.
nodes.statement_markdown: Let $1\le k\le N$ and $r_k=\lfloor(k-1)/H\rfloor$. After generator and manifest validation, $$\operatorname{Check}_{\mathrm{unsat}}(F_{k,r_k},\pi)=\mathrm{true}$$ implies soundness throughout $((k-1)/N,k/N]$, while $$\operatorname{Check}_{\mathrm{sat}}(F_{k,r_k},w)=\mathrm{true}$$ implies nonsoundness throughout that cell.

nodes.label: Point-degree relaxation boundary
nodes.notes: Any useful outer program must add line-side or polynomial-label constraints.
nodes.statement_markdown: The affine point-line incidence graph is $K_{2,2}$-free, and $$\{(\deg_G(x))_{x\in X}:G\subseteq\operatorname{Inc}(X,\mathcal L)\}=\prod_{x\in X}\{0,\ldots,p+1\}.$$ Thus point-degree histograms alone impose no additional feasibility restriction.

nodes.label: Explicit finite outer relaxation
nodes.notes: No complete branch family or bad-instance coverage theorem is stored.
nodes.statement_markdown: For each $(k,r)$ there are a finite set $\Theta_{k,r}$ and explicit integer systems $\Phi_\theta$ such that $$\operatorname{BadIP}(k,r)\text{ feasible}\Longrightarrow\bigvee_{\theta\in\Theta_{k,r}}\exists z\in\mathbb Z^{s_\theta}:\Phi_\theta(k,r,z).$$ Every branch retains explicit line-side or polynomial-label information, so exact infeasibility certificates for all branches imply infeasibility of $\operatorname{BadIP}(k,r)$.

nodes.label: Hash-bound R7 rational ledger
nodes.notes: The R7 manifest binds note SHA-256 `8faf0714244fadebd63b29c3c3c4402b36974bc1803bdbdd6402c54f70f293e9`; both auditors reran its integer/Fraction script. This certifies only the displayed scalar ledger.

nodes.label: Doubly audited R7 source theorem
nodes.notes: This is the exact indexed P10 statement, not a lower neighboring-cell strengthening.
nodes.statement_markdown: For every instance $c$, $$\frac{A(c)}N\ge\varepsilon_7\Longrightarrow\frac{G(f)}M\ge\frac{\varepsilon_7}{10}.$$ Hence $\operatorname{Sound}(\varepsilon_7)$ and $G(f)\ge781092078$ under the displayed acceptance hypothesis.

nodes.label: Whole R7 source count cell
nodes.notes: This is an elementary count-cell corollary, not a separately indexed source theorem.

nodes.label: Exact affine incidence mixing
nodes.notes: This universal form is reusable beyond the source-specific R7 core.
nodes.statement_markdown: For $Y\subseteq X$ and $T\subseteq\mathcal L$, put $a=|Y|/M$, $b=|T|/\Lambda$, and $J(Y,T)=I(Y,T)/N$. Then $$|J(Y,T)-ab|\le\sqrt{\frac{a(1-a)b(1-b)}{p+1}}.$$

nodes.label: Tight hypergeometric endpoint bounds
nodes.notes: Exact alternating-binomial replay establishes the displayed inequalities locally, but no stable hash-bound certificate stores them.

nodes.label: Finite pencil-energy envelope
nodes.notes: This is a finite family of $147459$ exact rational inequalities. R7 P2 states only its fixed-score consequence.
nodes.statement_markdown: Let $\phi_a=aH_a$ and $j=51837$. For every integer $0\le a\le P_0$, $$\phi_a\le\frac{(P_0-a)\phi_j+(a-j)\phi_{P_0}}{P_0-j}.$$

nodes.label: Acceptance-parametric energy selection
nodes.notes: The fixed-score P2 hash is intentionally absent from this strengthened statement.
nodes.statement_markdown: For every acceptance graph $E$ with $A=|E|/N\ge j/P_0$, there is an $r$-line set $R$ such that, if $U_R$ counts accepted incidences at points whose accepted pencils miss $R$, then $$\frac{U_R}{N}<\Delta_*(A):=\frac{j(1-A)h_j^*+(P_0A-j)h_P^*}{P_0-j},$$ where $$h_j^*=\frac{2387626371315326}{10^{16}},\qquad h_P^*=\frac{170031583622226}{10^{16}}.$$

nodes.label: Two-incidence exact rational boundary
nodes.notes: The negative neighboring value shows that these endpoint bounds alone cannot gain a third incidence.

nodes.label: Score-independent R7 core ledger
nodes.notes: R7 P3--P6 provide source-specific ancestry, but no indexed step states this universal implication.
nodes.statement_markdown: For every acceptance graph $E$ and every $r$-line set $R$, if $$|E|>U_R+C_0,$$ then there is a nonempty subgraph with minimum point and line degrees $(17643,5495)$ carrying a primitive squarefree polynomial $B$ of weighted degree at most $17642$, formal line-label roots, and $B_Z(x,f(x))\ne0$ at every retained point.

nodes.label: Generic component-mass transfer
nodes.notes: R7 P8 proves this only for the exact P6 core, so its hash is intentionally absent.
nodes.statement_markdown: Every connected component of any nonempty affine-incidence subgraph with minimum point and line degrees $(17643,5495)$ has point density greater than $\tau_7$ and therefore contains at least $781092078$ point vertices.

nodes.label: Generic simple-root recovery
nodes.notes: R7 P9 is source-core-specific; the invariant-parametric KTZ lifting statement still needs its own indexed proof.
nodes.statement_markdown: Every connected component of a core satisfying `cc-r7-generic-core` is labeled on all its point vertices by one polynomial $Q\in F[X,Y]$ of total degree at most $87$.

nodes.label: R7 two-incidence refinement
nodes.notes: This is the strongest substantive round-6 target and remains blocked by the exact strengthened interfaces.

nodes.label: Hash-bound two-incidence UNSAT artifact
nodes.notes: This is an analytic-independent alternative to the generic R7 bridge. No required formula or proof artifact is stored.
nodes.statement_markdown: For $$k_2=1151782755825592,\qquad r_7=781092077,$$ canonical generated bytes, checker bytes, a complete UNSAT proof $\pi$, and a length-and-digest manifest satisfy all validations and $$\operatorname{Check}_{\mathrm{unsat}}(F_{k_2,r_7},\pi)=\mathrm{true}.$$

nodes.label: Constant-polynomial integer certificate
nodes.notes: This is a $p$-variable pigeonhole certificate independent of acceptance.
nodes.statement_markdown: For $n_b(f)=|\{x:f(x)=b\}|$, the integer system $$\sum_{b\in F}n_b=M,\qquad0\le n_b\le p-1$$ is infeasible. Hence some constant polynomial agrees with $f$ on at least $p$ points, so $$G(f)\ge p,\qquad\operatorname{Agr}_{87}(f)\ge\frac1p.$$

nodes.label: Universal low-score interval
nodes.notes: The acceptance hypothesis is unused.
nodes.statement_markdown: Every rational $\varepsilon$ satisfying $$0<\varepsilon\le\frac{10}{147457}$$ belongs to $\mathcal S$.

nodes.label: No lowest positive score
nodes.notes: The sound terminating decimals $10^{-n}$ for $n\ge5$ already converge to zero.
nodes.statement_markdown: The rational sound-score set satisfies $$\inf\mathcal S=0$$ and has no least element. The same conclusion holds after restricting admissible scores to positive terminating decimals.

nodes.label: Exact nonsound interval
nodes.notes: This accepted construction demonstrates that the literal score predicate is nonmonotone.
nodes.statement_markdown:
There exists an instance $c$ such that $$A(c)\ge88\Lambda=1913446858928,
\qquad G(f)\le2p-1=294913.$$ Consequently, $$\left[\frac{20}{147457},\frac{88}{147457}\right]\cap\mathbb Q$$ is disjoint from $\mathcal S$.

nodes.label: Exact finite characterization and literal target resolution
nodes.notes: Raw enumeration is infeasible in practice. The certificate branch gives an independently checkable route for selected cells; the two-incidence cell remains open.
nodes.statement_markdown: The rational sound-score set is exactly $$\mathcal S=\mathbb Q\cap\bigcup_{\substack{1\le k\le N\\C_{\lfloor(k-1)/H\rfloor}<k}}\left(\frac{k-1}{N},\frac{k}{N}\right]$$ $$=\mathbb Q\cap\bigcup_{\substack{1\le k\le N\\\operatorname{BadIP}(k,\lfloor(k-1)/H\rfloor)\ \mathrm{infeasible}}}\left(\frac{k-1}{N},\frac{k}{N}\right].$$ Every indexing predicate is decidable by exact finite enumeration. Moreover, $(0,10/147457]\cap\mathbb Q\subseteq\mathcal S$, the complete R7 source cell lies in $\mathcal S$, and $[20/147457,88/147457]\cap\mathbb Q$ is nonsound. Therefore the requested lowest positive rational or terminating-decimal soundness score does not exist.

roadmaps.summary: Round 6 preserves the exact computational spine: integer-aligned score cells, a finite bad-profile function, an explicit $0$--$1$ program, Reed--Muller coset normalization, anchored local enumeration, and sound generator/checker interfaces. The corpus still has $138$ stable steps and $68$ double accepts; its only addition is the researcher-0010 Lemma Book extraction, which does not change R10's `revise,revise` status. R7 P10 remains the best accepted acceptance-driven theorem. Exact rounding promotes it to the full count cell containing $0.35922904602094685$. Tight hypergeometric arithmetic supports a provisional two-incidence cell containing $0.3592290460209463$, but the strengthened energy, generic-core, component-mass, recovery, and direct-UNSAT obligations remain unverified and are kept evidence-free. Finally, accepted constant-polynomial evidence proves every $0<\varepsilon\le10/147457$ sound, while an accepted construction gives a later nonsound interval. Thus the literal optimization has infimum $0$ and no least positive rational or terminating-decimal score.
roadmaps.target_statement: At $m=2$, $p=147457$, and total degree $87$, characterize the rational sound-score set by exact finite profiles and bad-instance integer programs; provide sound hash-bound SAT, UNSAT, and rational-arithmetic certificate interfaces; record the accepted R7 source cell and the blocked two-incidence refinement; and prove that the literal lowest-positive-$\varepsilon$ objective has no solution.

nodes.label: Fixed prime certificate
nodes.notes: Pocklington supplies the fixed field used throughout the chain.
nodes.statement_markdown: Let $p=147457$. The identities $$p-1=2^{14}3^2,$$ $$10^{p-1}\equiv1\pmod p,\quad 10^{(p-1)/2}\equiv147456\pmod p,\quad 10^{(p-1)/3}\equiv78348\pmod p,$$ and $$\gcd(147455,p)=\gcd(78347,p)=1$$ imply that $p$ is prime.

nodes.label: Fixed protocol and soundness predicate
nodes.notes: All probabilities use the uniform affine-line-then-uniform-point incidence distribution.
nodes.statement_markdown: Set $F=\mathbb F_{147457}$, $$M:=p^2=21743566849,\quad P_0:=p+1=147458,$$ $$\Lambda:=pP_0=21743714306,\quad N:=p\Lambda=3206262880419842.$$ For $f:F^2\to F$ and degree-at-most-$87$ line labels $P_L$, let $$E:=\{(x,L):x\in L,\ P_L(x)=f(x)\},\qquad \operatorname{Pass}(f,P):=\frac{|E|}{N},$$ and $$\operatorname{Agr}_{87}(f):=\max_{\deg_{\mathrm{total}}Q\le87}\Pr_{x\in F^2}[Q(x)=f(x)].$$ Put $$\varepsilon_7:=\frac{359229046020947}{10^{15}},\qquad \tau_7:=\frac{\varepsilon_7}{10}.$$

nodes.label: R7 fixed arithmetic ledger
nodes.notes: These are the single fixed choices used in the accepted R7 chain.

nodes.label: Whole-pencil hypergeometric envelope
nodes.notes: The global chord controls every possible accepted degree of a point.
nodes.statement_markdown: For $0\le a\le P_0$, define $$H_a:=\frac{\binom{\Lambda-a}{r}}{\binom{\Lambda}{r}},\qquad \phi_a:=aH_a.$$ Put $$h_j:=\frac{238762637131533}{10^{15}},\qquad h_{P_0}:=\frac{17003158362223}{10^{15}}.$$ Then $H_j<h_j$, $H_{P_0}<h_{P_0}$, and $$\phi_a\le\frac{(P_0-a)jH_j+(a-j)P_0H_{P_0}}{P_0-j}$$ for every integer $a\in[0,P_0]$.

nodes.label: Exact-size line selection
nodes.notes: Missed accepted pencils are the only loss charged at this stage.
nodes.statement_markdown: For $N_E(x):=\{L:(x,L)\in E\}$ and an $r$-line set $R$, put $$U_R:=\sum_{x:N_E(x)\cap R=\varnothing}|N_E(x)|.$$ If $\operatorname{Pass}(f,P)\ge\varepsilon_7$, there exists $R\subseteq\mathcal L$ with $|R|=600782$ and $$\frac{U_R}{N}<\delta_7,$$ where $$\delta_7:=\frac{7949939667036172399086139222913311}{95621000000000000000000000000000000}.$$

nodes.label: Source-specific line rigidity
nodes.notes: This is the precise rigidity interface imported by R7 P3.
nodes.statement_markdown: If $S\in F[X,Y]$ has total degree at most $D$ and vanishes formally on more than $D$ distinct affine lines, then $S=0$. Since $|R|=r>D$, every nonzero weighted interpolation relation vanishing on all selected labeled-line graphs depends on $Z$.

nodes.label: Squarefree weighted relation
nodes.notes: Minimum weighted degree is taken over every eligible relation with nonzero $Z$-derivative.
nodes.statement_markdown: There exists a nonzero squarefree polynomial $\mathcal A\in F[X,Y,Z]$ such that $$\operatorname{wdeg}_{(1,1,87)}\mathcal A\le D,\qquad \mathcal A_Z\ne0,$$ and $$\mathcal A(L(t),P_L(t))\equiv0\qquad(L\in R).$$

nodes.label: Mass-preserving identity transfer
nodes.notes: Every excluded line is charged by at most $D$ hit incidences.
nodes.statement_markdown: Call $(x,L)\in E$ hit when $N_E(x)\cap R\ne\varnothing$. Let $T$ contain $R$ and every $L\notin R$ with more than $D$ hit accepted incidences; put $t:=|T|$ and $E_T:=\{(x,L)\in E:L\in T\}$. Then $$\mathcal A(L(t),P_L(t))\equiv0\qquad(L\in T)$$ and $$|E|\le |E_T|+U_R+D(\Lambda-t).$$

nodes.label: Primitive discriminant cleanup
nodes.notes: The nominal-degree discriminant handles leading-coefficient drops without division.
nodes.statement_markdown: Write $\mathcal A=CB$, where $C\in F[X,Y]$ is the coefficient content in $Z$ and $B$ is primitive. Then $B$ is squarefree, $$\operatorname{wdeg}_{(1,1,87)}B\le D,\quad \deg_ZB\le202<p,\quad \gcd(B,B_Z)=1.$$ There is $\mathcal E\subseteq T$, with $e:=|\mathcal E|\le E_D$, such that every $L\in T\setminus\mathcal E$ satisfies $$B(L(t),P_L(t))\equiv0,$$ while $B_Z(L(t),P_L(t))$ is nonzero of degree at most $q=17555$.

nodes.label: Earliest-deletion charge
nodes.notes: Each removed edge is charged at its first applicable deletion rule.
nodes.statement_markdown: Delete all edges on $\mathcal E$, all remaining $(x,L)\in E_T$ with $B_Z(x,f(x))=0$, and then iteratively points of current degree at most $D$ and lines of current degree at most $s-1$. If every edge is deleted, then $$|E_T|\le pe+q(t-e)+DM+(s-1)(t-e).$$

nodes.label: Exact R7 survival ledger
nodes.notes: The strict rational surplus rules out complete deletion.
nodes.statement_markdown: Complete deletion implies $$|E|\le U_R+C_0,$$ where $$C_0:=DM+(q+s-1)\Lambda+(p-q-s+1)E_D=885213733790732.$$ Moreover, $$\varepsilon_7-\frac{C_0}{N}-\delta_7=\frac{67333805766276738068309588974841569}{153293031444312855941000000000000000000000000000000}>0.$$ Hence $\operatorname{Pass}(f,P)\ge\varepsilon_7$ makes complete deletion impossible.

nodes.label: Nonempty simple-root core
nodes.notes: This records exactly the structural output needed by mixing and recovery.
nodes.statement_markdown: There is a nonempty retained graph $$G_*=(X_*,\mathcal T_*,E_*)$$ of minimum point degree at least $D+1=17643$ and minimum line degree at least $s=5495$ such that $$B(L(t),P_L(t))\equiv0\qquad(L\in\mathcal T_*),$$ and every $x\in X_*$ satisfies $$B(x,f(x))=0,\qquad B_Z(x,f(x))\ne0.$$

nodes.label: Centered affine incidence mixing
nodes.notes: The universal mixing inequality is placed at its first use in the spine.
nodes.statement_markdown: For $X\subseteq F^2$ and a line set $S$, let $a:=|X|/M$ and $b:=|S|/\Lambda$. Their ambient incidence count satisfies $$\frac{I(X,S)}N\le ab+\sqrt{\frac{a(1-a)b(1-b)}{P_0}}.$$

nodes.label: Every source core component is large
nodes.notes: The integer form is the agreement count later used for joint cell rounding.
nodes.statement_markdown: Every connected component $K=(X_K,\mathcal T_K,E_K)$ of $G_*$ satisfies $$\frac{|X_K|}{M}>\tau_7.$$ Consequently, every component contains at least $781092078$ point vertices.

nodes.label: Source-specific simple-root reconstruction
nodes.notes: This is applied only to the exact P6 core; generic reuse is separated below.
nodes.statement_markdown: Let $K$ be a connected component of $G_*$ and $b\in X_K$. The at least $D+1$ incident degree-at-most-$87$ line labels are formal roots of $B$ with common simple value $f(b)$. There exists $Q_K\in F[X,Y]$ of total degree at most $87$ satisfying $$B(X,Y,Q_K(X,Y))\equiv0$$ and agreeing with every seed-line label. At every reached point, simple-root uniqueness identifies $Q_K$ with each adjacent line label.

nodes.label: One global polynomial on a component
nodes.notes: Selecting one component is sufficient; different components need not share their polynomial.
nodes.statement_markdown: For every connected component $K$ of $G_*$, there exists one polynomial $$Q_K\in F[X,Y],\qquad \deg_{\mathrm{total}}Q_K\le87,$$ such that $$Q_K(x)=f(x)\qquad(x\in X_K).$$

nodes.label: R7 source soundness theorem
nodes.notes: This node matches the indexed P10 endpoint statement.
nodes.statement_markdown: For every fixed-instance point and line table, $$\operatorname{Pass}(f,P)\ge\varepsilon_7\Longrightarrow\exists Q\in F[X,Y],\ \deg_{\mathrm{total}}Q\le87:\ \Pr_x[Q(x)=f(x)]\ge\frac{\varepsilon_7}{10}.$$

nodes.label: Joint acceptance and recovery cell alignment
nodes.notes: This is an elementary integer deduction from P10, not an indexed source step.
nodes.statement_markdown: Let $$C:=10P_0=1474580,\quad k_7:=1151782755825594,\quad r_7:=781092077.$$ The identities $$359229046020947N=(k_7-1)10^{15}+509686886430374,$$ $$359229046020947M=r_7\,10^{16}+6258958548786003,$$ and $$k_7-1=r_7C+922933$$ give $$\lceil N\varepsilon_7\rceil=k_7,\qquad \left\lceil\frac{M\varepsilon_7}{10}\right\rceil=r_7+1.$$ Thus, for every rational $$(k_7-1)/N<\varepsilon\le k_7/N,$$ the hypothesis $\operatorname{Pass}(f,P)\ge\varepsilon$ forces $|E|\ge k_7$ and hence the source theorem, while $$\frac{M\varepsilon}{10}\le\frac{k_7}{C}<r_7+1.$$ Therefore its polynomial has agreement at least $\varepsilon/10$. Finally, for $$\varepsilon_*:=\frac{35922904602094685}{10^{17}},$$ $$35922904602094685N-(k_7-1)10^{17}=2874745436739770>0,$$ $$k_7 10^{17}-35922904602094685N=97125254563260230>0,$$ so $\varepsilon_*$ lies in this cell.

nodes.label: Full R7 count-cell soundness
nodes.notes: The open lower endpoint means this substantive cell has an infimum but no least rational representative.
nodes.statement_markdown: For every rational $$\frac{1151782755825593}{3206262880419842}<\varepsilon\le\frac{1151782755825594}{3206262880419842}=\frac{575891377912797}{1603131440209921},$$ every $f:F^2\to F$ and every degree-at-most-$87$ affine-line table satisfy $$\operatorname{Pass}(f,P)\ge\varepsilon\Longrightarrow\exists Q\in F[X,Y],\ \deg_{\mathrm{total}}Q\le87:\ \Pr_{x\in F^2}[Q(x)=f(x)]\ge\frac{\varepsilon}{10}.$$ In particular, the implication holds at $$\varepsilon_*=0.35922904602094685.$$

nodes.label: Universal constant-polynomial floor
nodes.notes: This conclusion is independent of the line table and its acceptance probability.
nodes.statement_markdown: Every $f:F^2\to F$ agrees with some constant polynomial on at least a $1/147457$ fraction of $F^2$.

nodes.label: The literal score set has no minimum
nodes.notes: This resolves the specification-level optimization separately from the substantive R7 cell.
nodes.statement_markdown: Let $\mathcal S\subseteq\mathbb Q\cap(0,1]$ be the scores satisfying the target implication. Then $$(0,10/147457]\cap\mathbb Q\subseteq\mathcal S.$$ Hence $\inf\mathcal S=0$, and neither the positive rational scores nor the positive terminating-decimal scores have a least element.

nodes.label: Accepted nonmonotonicity obstruction
nodes.notes: The constant-floor interval is not the beginning of a monotone soundness range.
nodes.statement_markdown: There exist $f$ and a degree-at-most-$87$ line table satisfying $$\operatorname{Pass}(f,P)\ge\frac{88}{147457},\qquad \operatorname{Agr}_{87}(f)<\frac2{147457}.$$ Consequently, the target implication fails for every $$\varepsilon\in\left[\frac{20}{147457},\frac{88}{147457}\right].$$

nodes.label: Independent R6 fallback
nodes.notes: This preserves a separate accepted architecture, although R7 is numerically stronger.
nodes.statement_markdown: If $$\operatorname{Pass}(f,P)\ge\frac{5759100500000001}{10^{16}},$$ then some $Q\in F[X,Y]$ of total degree at most $87$ satisfies $$\Pr_x[Q(x)=f(x)]\ge\frac{5759100500000001}{10^{17}}.$$

nodes.label: Point-degree relaxation barrier
nodes.notes: This does not rule out improvements using line-side, adaptive, or polynomial-label structure.
nodes.statement_markdown: The affine point-line incidence graph of $F^2$ contains no $K_{2,2}$. Moreover, for every family of integers $(a_x)_{x\in F^2}$ with $0\le a_x\le P_0$, there is an incidence subgraph whose point degrees are exactly $(a_x)_{x\in F^2}$.

nodes.label: Tight hypergeometric endpoints
nodes.notes: These sharper rational bounds are not the endpoint bounds stated by the indexed R7 P2.

nodes.label: Acceptance-parametric energy selection

roadmaps.summary: The complete fixed-parameter spine remains the R7 chain: whole-pencil energy selects $600782$ lines; weighted interpolation produces a squarefree relation of weighted degree $17642$; discriminant cleanup and earliest-deletion peeling leave a nonempty $(17643,5495)$ simple-root core; centered incidence mixing makes every component contain at least $781092078$ points; and source-specific lifting produces one total-degree-at-most-$87$ polynomial on a component. Round 6 strengthens the endpoint bookkeeping: joint integrality of both accepted incidences and recovered points extends the R7 theorem to the full cell $((k_7-1)/N,k_7/N]$, including $\varepsilon_*=0.35922904602094685$. This cell has no least rational member. More fundamentally, the literal score set has no positive minimum because constant polynomials prove every $0<\varepsilon\le10/147457$. The lower provisional value $0.3592290460209463$ requires new parametric energy, generic ledger, generic mass, and generic recovery lemmas and therefore remains blocked. R9 P13 supplies only unaudited ancestry for a larger nonsound interval.
